name: shader-light-tunnel
title: Light Tunnel
description: A forward flight through a tunnel of luminous, twisting light ribbons with a halftone texture and a soft defocused vanishing point, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: A title reveal or product intro needs a luminous forward flight through a tunnel.
Light ribbons should have perspective, depth and soft atmospheric glow.
avoidWhen: A quiet background should leave attention on dense UI: use shader-mesh-gradient.
You need a flat liquid distortion instead of forward flight: use shader-warp.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Twist
variables.description: Spiral winding and circular motion of the ribbons.

variables.label: Spirals
variables.description: Repetitions of the ribbons around the tunnel.

variables.label: Start time
variables.description: Where the flight starts, in seconds.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders much faster: the light field is costly to draw in software.
